_about: Which third-party leaderboards have listed which Claude release, and when the site last looked. Edit here, then run `python3 scripts/build-site-data.py`; the Board Coverage section of claude-models.html is drawn from it. See data/README.md.

_fields.boards[].tracked_since: the site keeps (model, board) records for releases from this date on; older releases show as a dash in the matrix. A release on or after it with no row below is queued automatically as pending, never checked
_fields.boards[].default_status: optional: the status a new release gets on this board when it has no row (default pending)
_fields.boards[].last_checked: the date the whole board was last read. It is the last_checked of every pending or listed row of that board that does not set its own, so a re-check that finds nothing new is this one edit
_fields.checks[].model: release id from models.json; the release date comes from there
_fields.checks[].first_listed: a real listing date: one the board itself states, or the release day when a dated read that day already found the entry. Needs first_listed_basis. Only these feed the typical-lag figure
_fields.checks[].first_seen_by_site: the date of the site's own read (or, failing a stated read, the commit) that first had the entry. An UPPER BOUND on the listing date, never the listing date
_fields.checks[].not_listed_as_of: optional lower bound: the last dated read that found no entry
_fields.checks[].last_checked: optional per-row override of the board's last_checked (null = never checked)
_fields.checks[].value: the board's figure when listed, as the site plots or quotes it
_fields.checks[].note: what the site knows and how
